verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI ("wally"/rcli) documented in detail — browser-based auth, `--cloud` flag, offline local mode, `wally account whoami/usage`, and a GitHub releases page for it — showing real agentic CLI functionality. But hands-on community reports directly contradict a working experience: a segmentation fault running the CLI, broken installs via Homebrew, and voice/tool-calling commands silently failing ("navigated to google.com" when nothing happened), which the vendor's own community had to acknowledge. Missing for 10: independent confirmation the CLI works reliably post-install, clarification of rcli vs wally naming, and resolution of the reported crashes/install bugs.
